all visible context. Do not invent a numeric similarity judgment or assume that
a higher transfer_likelihood must outweigh a concrete experimental mismatch.

every compound-specific empirical claim in the supplied query prior or cited
record cards. Repeated records and multiple cards from one context are not

claims.claim: The query is a 2,4-diaminopyrimidine bearing a 3,4,5-trimethoxybenzyl group; the closest structural contexts (trimetazidine, fostamatinib, rigosertib, colchicine) all contain the trimethoxyphenyl/trimethoxybenzyl motif and report absolute oral bioavailability values of 34.8-88.7%, all above the 20% threshold.

Additional contexts with less structural similarity also report F values above 20% (acitretin ~59-60%, etoposide ~50%, etoposide phosphate 68%, estragole 32%, isoeugenol 35.8-39%), providing no contrary evidence.
No L1 record affirmatively supports F <20%; the lowest reported point/mean estimates are still above the threshold (e.g., rigosertib 34.8%, estragole 32%, colchicine means 37-47%).

evidence_gaps: No direct absolute oral bioavailability measurement for the query molecule was supplied; the decision is based on transfer from structurally related contexts and a physicochemical prior.
No query-specific data on first-pass metabolism, efflux transport, or formulation-dependent absorption were supplied.
